definitions.explanation: Dividing or distributing something—typically money, costs, or quantities—proportionally according to a set ratio or standard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{按分|あんぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使用面積|しようめんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧{按分|あんぶん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The rent is apportioned according to the floor area used.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{按分|あんぶん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you also use your home for work, you can prorate utility costs and claim them as business expenses.

notes:
A practical term frequently encountered in accounting, tax filing, and shared-cost situations. The word implies a fair, mathematically proportional split rather than an equal division.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {按分|あんぶん}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: apportionment ratio
- {按分|あんぶん}⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: prorating calculation
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{按分|あんぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prorate expenses
- ⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧{按分|あんぶん}: area-based apportionment
- {按分|あんぶん}{票|ひょう}: apportioned votes (in elections)

WRITING:
Also written as {案分|あんぶん} with a different first character. Both spellings are widely used, though {按分|あんぶん} is more common in tax and accounting contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配分|はいぶん}→配分：14495_haibun⟧: distribution, allocation — dividing something among parties, but not necessarily proportionally
- ⟦{分配|ぶんぱい}→分配：11746_bunpai⟧: distribution, sharing — general term for dividing and giving out
- ⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧: splitting the bill — specifically for dividing a restaurant or bar bill equally
